Imagine a backyard like this!! #luxurylisting 
Make your dreams come true and buy this beautiful home on great property in Belton, Texas.
Located at: 12641 FM 93, Belton, TX 76513
What makes it stand out?
✅ Drive-through access with parking at both the front and back
✅ Tons of space for tools, equipment, or outdoor rec storage
✅ Perfect for woodworking, mechanics, homesteading, or RV storage
✅ Just steps away from a fully updated 3,000 sq ft custom home

This property also includes:
🏡 3 beds with ensuite bathrooms
🪟 A panoramic bonus “Treehouse” room
🌲 Private Nolan Creek access + forested backyard
🚿 Self-sufficient well + septic system
🚌 Full RV hook-ups for guests or travelers

Whether you're a hands-on homeowner or want the ultimate backyard bonus, this workshop is ready to deliver.
